finding_key: packages/frontend/scripts/verify-visual-browser.mjs::adding index.html's own families (inter/fraunces/jetbrains mono) to the font gate makes every visual capture, in every section, hard-depend on fonts.googleapis.com resolving within 10s
evidence: Verified against the diff and supplied files: index.html:12 registers Inter/Fraunces/JetBrains Mono on every page, VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES now includes them, and capturePass() calls waitForFontsReady() for every profile×section pass, whose check-poll (verify-visual-browser.mjs ~line 384) hard-fails after 10s if those faces never load; document.fonts.check() only returned true trivially before because the listed families were unregistered on non-slides pages. The .catch(() => {}) on fonts.load does convert fetch failures into per-page timeouts. The claim's mechanism is accurate; severity is tempered because the baselines already encode Inter glyphs (a no-egress run would fail pixel diffs anyway) and the PR's task doc explicitly accepts this trade-off.
